production_preconditions: Normal reviewed budget account and activation, current script approval, actual measured speech and other ordinary gates must be satisfied first.
Read current live provider/model/dimensions/reference hashes/image-selection version; declared local key examples are not live provider readiness or a quote.
Generate and accept the payoff scene once via the ordinary keyframes --shot PAYOFF --takes 1 route.

Before executing any teaser command, compute the exact current request key and inspect the ordinary live cache record plus the real stored file SHA. Cache must already contain the accepted payoff bytes. A cache miss, missing/unreadable file, hash mismatch, request difference or selection change stops the pair before a second dispatch; never use a request as a cache probe.
Only after that read-only live cache proof, use ordinary keyframes --shot SETUP --takes 1 with the exact same request inputs. Both scene contexts still require their own real judge acceptance.
Do not independently retake a teaser or change its seed. If either context fails, stop and reconcile/review the pair together under the ordinary guarded workflow.
After any subtitle-band trim or other derivative, compare actual final manifest assignments and bytes: teaser and payoff must use the same accepted file SHA. If not, stop before render.
Decode actual final assembly and verify both positions use that same accepted still, with no duplicate teaser purchase on the ledger.
